Digi Sushi

Type
Food / Care Item
ID
thedigimod:digi_sushi

Usage

A food/care item. Digimon have individual diet preferences ranked in the Digivice GUI - see What Do I Feed My Digimon?.

Obtaining

Crafted. See the Crafting section below for the pattern and ingredients.

Crafting

Shapeless recipe: the ingredients can go in any slots.
